answer_text:
Published research from September 2026 does not report a specific total count of different web domains cited by Perplexity when answering local business recommendation questions.
Available September 2026 studies cover related metrics rather than that exact figure:
UX Continuum (Matt Turley, September 24, 2026): Analyzed 3,118 answers across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini to "who should I hire" and "what should I use" questions, finding Perplexity cited an average of 20.0 sources per answer (and listed top cited domains rather than a total unique domain count for Perplexity on local business questions).
BrightLocal (September 16, 2026): Analyzed roughly 200,000 local searches and ~1.97 million citations across ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Google AI Overviews (not Perplexity), finding roughly 116,000 unique domains overall (~93% individual business websites). neurova-ai.com +1
